Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At “一个很漂亮的植物”, add one visual detail to show why it is beautiful, such as “开着黄色的像星星一样的花”.
2. After “又香又好看”, show Shennong’s reaction with an internal thought, such as “神农心想：这种植物也许能做药。”
3. At the end of the scene, add a small action to build suspense before he tries the plant, such as “他小心地摘下一片叶子，放进嘴里。”

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete visual detail and the Chinese is appropriate for an early learner.
He has already traveled there because he heard the plant can make sick people feel better.
This is a concrete action that fits Shennong tasting plants and leads naturally to the next event.
